name: RotationEffect
description: Represents a rotation effect for an AnimationBehavior object.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

properties.name: By
properties.description: Sets or returns a Single that represents the rotation of an object by the specified number of degrees; for example, a value of 180 means to rotate the object by 180 degrees. Read/write.

properties.name: From
properties.description: Sets or returns a Single that represents the starting angle in degrees, specified relative to the screen (for example, 90 degrees is completely horizontal). Read/write.

properties.name: To
properties.description: Sets or returns a Single that represents the ending rotation of an object in degrees, specified relative to the screen (for example, 90 degrees is completely horizontal). Read/write.
